entries.line: Step away from that {container}. Those blades were stored for the village, not for quiet hands.

options.label: Return it
options.response: Good. A blade taken in secret cuts trust first.

options.label: Accept warning
options.response: You have earned enough respect that I will call this foolish, not hostile. Do not test that twice.

options.label: Pay for the steel
options.response: Steel is easy to price. Trust is not.

take_items.success_response: Ten emeralds covers the stock. It does not make the taking clean.
take_items.failure_response: You cannot pay ten emeralds. Then you cannot buy your way out of this.

options.label: Make restitution
options.response: With your history, I price the risk higher than the metal.

take_items.success_response: Twenty emeralds. Now leave the steel where villagers can find it.

options.label: Threaten them
options.response: Then draw your answer.

entries.line: That {container} holds offerings and remedies. Taking from it takes from the frightened and the sick.

options.label: Return it
options.response: Return it, then let your next kindness arrive before your next mistake.

options.label: Ask forgiveness
options.response: Forgiveness is not a lid you close. It is a habit you rebuild.

options.label: Offer restitution
options.response: Restitution should help the village heal.

take_items.success_response: Twelve emeralds will refill what fear empties. Do not touch the temple stores again.
take_items.failure_response: You cannot offer what you do not carry.

options.label: Dismiss them
options.response: Then you do not understand what you took.

entries.line: Careful with that {container}. Maps look like paper until someone depends on the route.

options.label: Close it
options.response: Good. Some paths should be offered, not taken.

options.label: Ask for a map
options.response: Ask properly later. A good direction starts with permission.

options.label: Accept warning
options.response: You have followed our directions before. I will trust you to step back now.

options.label: Deny it
options.response: I know what an opened chest sounds like. I map more than roads.

entries.line: That {container} is not a display case. It is what stands between villagers and teeth.

options.label: Close it
options.response: Good. Armor kept in place protects more than armor carried off.

options.label: Offer payment
options.response: Payment is not permission, but it proves you understand there was a cost.

take_items.success_response: Four emeralds, and the chest stays closed.
take_items.failure_response: You do not have four emeralds. Then close the chest with an empty hand.

options.label: Explain the danger
options.response: If danger is coming, say that first. A village can arm itself faster than it can forgive theft.

options.label: Threaten them
options.response: Then you are the danger.

entries.line: Stop right there. That {container} was stocked for this village, and I watched you take from it.

options.label: I will put it back
options.response: Then do it now. A village remembers the hand that returns what it took.

options.label: Apologize
options.response: An apology is a start. Closed lids and empty hands are better.

options.label: Accept warning
options.response: Your name still carries weight here, so I will treat this as a mistake. Do not make me regret it.

options.label: Offer payment
options.response: Payment after taking is not permission. Still, making it right matters.

take_items.success_response: Eight emeralds will help replace what you took. Consider this a warning, not a purchase.
take_items.failure_response: You do not have eight emeralds to offer. Do not promise payment with empty pockets.

options.label: Offer costly payment
options.response: With your reputation, replacing trust costs more than replacing goods.

take_items.success_response: Sixteen emeralds pays for the risk you keep bringing to our doors. Do better, or there will not be another price.
take_items.failure_response: You do not have sixteen emeralds. Even your apology comes up short.

options.label: I needed supplies
options.response: Need asks before it takes. If you are hungry, speak to us like a neighbor.

options.label: I thought it was abandoned
options.response: A quiet chest is not an abandoned one. These stores keep roofs standing.

options.label: I was only borrowing it
options.response: Borrowing has a witness before and a return after. You skipped the first half.

options.label: Deny it
options.response: I watched your hands. Do not make the lie worse than the theft.

options.label: Threaten them
options.response: Then we are past words.

entries.line: Stop right there. That {container} is not yours to empty.

options.label: Apologize
options.response: Words are easy after the lid closes. Put your hands to better use.

options.label: I will put it back
options.response: Good. Let your next choice be quieter and kinder.

options.label: Deny it
options.response: I watched you take from it. Do not make me repeat myself.

options.label: Threaten them
options.response: Then we are past talking.

entries.line: Careful. That {container} was stocked for the village, not passing hands.

options.label: Close it
options.response: Good. Leave village stores for village needs.

options.label: Ask permission
options.response: Ask before the lid opens next time. We share better with people who speak first.

options.label: Offer payment
options.response: Coins help less than respect, but I hear the effort in it.

take_items.success_response: Three emeralds is enough for me to believe you meant no harm. Ask before touching village stores again.
take_items.failure_response: You do not have three emeralds to offer. Close the chest and choose your next words carefully.

options.label: Accept warning
options.response: You have helped this village before, so I will believe this was carelessness. Close it, and ask next time.

options.label: I was checking supplies
options.response: Then check with a villager beside you. Alone, it looks like hunger with pockets.

options.label: I need help
options.response: Need is not shameful. Taking without asking is. Speak plainly next time.

options.label: I thought it was abandoned
options.response: If the village still stands, its stores still belong to someone.

options.label: Deny it
options.response: The lid opened under your hand. Do not ask me to mistrust my own eyes.

options.label: Threaten them
options.response: Then we are past words.
